headlines.title: Two more violating supertankers catch fire in Strait of Hormuz: IRGC Navy
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has announced that two supertankers violating maritime regulations have caught fire and exploded after striking sea mines, after attempting to navigate an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Palestinian groups say Israeli military operation in central Gaza violates ceasefire

headlines.title: Rights groups call for release of detained Shia clerics in Bahrain
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – Twenty human rights organizations have called for the release of detainees and the dropping of charges related to peaceful religious activities in Bahrain, expressing concern over the mass trial of Shia clerics and allegations of torture and forced confessions.

headlines.title: Six French nationals sentenced to life in prison in Iraq for Daesh membership
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – An Iraqi criminal court has sentenced six French nationals to life imprisonment for membership in the Daesh terrorist group, bringing the total number of French citizens convicted in the case to 16, according to local media.

headlines.title: Iran strongly warns neighbors against easing US aggression
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 19 (MNA) – Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned U.S. attacks on its southern coast, saying U.S. use of regional soil is aggression under UN Resolution 3314 and that Iran acted in self-defense by striking U.S. bases.

headlines.title: China backs Iran’s sovereignty, calls for lifting sanctions
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 19 (MNA) – China has reaffirmed its support for Iran’s sovereignty and security, calling for the immediate lifting of unilateral sanctions that it says are harming the Iranian population.

headlines.title: Fire breaks out aboard tanker targeted in Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 18 (MNA) – The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz yesterday, leaving one crew member missing.

headlines.title: Two violating supertankers explode in Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 19 (MNA) – Two violating supertankers exploded after hitting naval mines on the unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz and are burning near its southern coast with over 4 million barrels of crude oil, the IRGC Navy said.
